# Crimson Publishers

> > Open-access academic publisher specializing in peer-reviewed research across neurosurgery, infectious disease, psychiatry, and clinical medicine.

Crimson Publishers operates multiple scholarly journals including Techniques in Neurosurgery & Neurology (TNN), offering peer-reviewed research articles, case reports, and clinical studies. The platform focuses on advancing medical knowledge through open-access publishing in neurology, microbiology, infectious diseases, and mental health.

## Key Topics

- Open-access publishing
- Peer-reviewed research
- Neurosurgery techniques
- Infectious disease
- Antibiotic resistance
- Case reports
- Clinical medicine
- Bacteremia
- Carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae (CRE)
- Mycobacterium diagnostics
- Neurology
- Psychiatry
- Medical education
- Healthcare access equity

## Neurosurgery & Neurology Research

- [Extreme Lateral Infrajugular Transchondylar Versus Far Lateral Approach in 92 Patients, Indications and Outcome: 11 Years of Experience](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/tnn/fulltext/TNN.000575.php): 11-year comparative study of ELITE vs far lateral surgical approaches
- [Brain Parenchyma to Repair Spinal Cord Deficits](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/tnn/fulltext/TNN.000560.php): Stem cell research for spinal cord repair using brain parenchyma
- [Microvascular Task Trainer in Neurosurgical Residency Training: A Pilot Study](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/tnn/fulltext/TNN.000577.php): Pilot study on simulation-based microvascular neurosurgical training
- [Cognitive Impairment in Patients Operated for Non-traumatic Intracranial Hemorrhage](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/dcmp/fulltext/DCMP.000526.php): Study on cognitive outcomes post-intracranial hemorrhage surgery

## Infectious Disease & Microbiology

- [Global Clinical Epidemiology of Carbapenem-Resistant Enterobacteriaceae Bacteremia and Association with Mortality: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/cjmi/fulltext/CJMI.000569.php): Meta-analysis on CRE bacteremia mortality and risk factors globally
- [The Evaluation of the Speed-Oligo® Mycobacteria Assay for Identification of Mycobacterium spp. from Smear Positive and Negative Sputum Samples](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/cjmi/fulltext/CJMI.000533.php): Diagnostic assay evaluation for Speed-Oligo Mycobacteria detection
- [Response of Microbes Against Spice Extracts-A way to Cope with Antibiotic Resistance](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/cjmi/fulltext/CJMI.000554.php): Research on spice extracts as antimicrobials against antibiotic resistance
- [Bacteremia due to Opportunistic Infection in Times of Pandemic](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/cjmi/fulltext/CJMI.000600.php): Case report on opportunistic bacteremia during COVID-19 pandemic
- [Comments of Clinical and Microbiological Experience with Daptomycin in Chronic Osteomyelitis Treatment](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/cjmi/fulltext/CJMI.000535.php): Clinical experience using daptomycin for chronic osteomyelitis treatment

## Clinical Case Reports

- [Report of 2 Cases of Allergic Bronchopulmonary Aspergillosis](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/cjmi/fulltext/CJMI.000617.php): Clinical case report on allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis diagnosis
- [Re-Examining the Genetic Bottleneck: Atavistic Regression in Acquired Traits Affects the Outcome for Many Subspecies at the Allelic Level](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/cjmi/fulltext/CJMI.000556.php): Genetics research on atavistic regression and allelic variation

## Psychiatry & Mental Health

- [Emotional Issues are More Evident among Youngsters: Need for Healthy Emotional Management](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/dcmp/fulltext/DCMP.000519.php): Youth mental health research on emotional competency development
- [Medical Care in the United States: Does Everyone Have Equal Access?](https://www.crimsonpublishers.com/dcmp/fulltext/DCMP.000517.php): Healthcare access equity analysis in the United States
